answer: Provenance-chain auditing resists sybils: every graded answer carries an immutable chain of its authoring and grading events, and auditors trace whether grades came from identities with independent provenance or from one anchor cluster. A ring's work all traces back to the same basalt root — a vertex of shared origin that honest independent provenance never shows. When grade provenance collapses onto a single lineage, the cluster is flagged and down-weighted; genuine graders scatter across unrelated histories the ring cannot fabricate.
